verdict.rationale: The evidence shows first-party routing built into the Angular platform (angular-docs-3), and a community comment cites Angular Universal for server-side prerendering (angular-comm-5). Together these cover only part of a full-stack layer, and nothing in the pack describes an official meta-framework built on top of Angular. Missing for 10: evidence of an official full-stack meta-framework, documented server-side data-fetching/loader patterns, first-party docs confirming Angular Universal as official, and current hands-on corroboration.
